LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_FusangRobe.label: (Raven) Fusang Robe
LanguageData.Raven_Apparel_FusangRobe.description: The exclusive ceremonial robe of Raven Fusang commanders. Its design exudes majesty and mystery, while the fabric incorporates Raven Darkfeather Steel fibers for excellent protection. It has now been declassified, allowing ordinary Raven members to wear it as well.
